name: s81hc_ccfh2_ref-v6-native-spine-COMMIT
purpose: v6 native (S-ELEM-PQ/CCF 2026-10-16, audit results/rtl/s81_hc_ccf_native_0030/native_audit_s81_hc_hrow_0030.json: R 539.1 / spread 171.2 / launch 408.2 ch_rst / capture 544.3 fv_i[2]). Measured on the v5 routed ODB: (1) clock = TritonCTS H-tree of 13-15 BUFx24 stages (fanout 1-2, 25-37 ps each, avg sink wire 479 um, 602 dummy loads) -> boundary 497..668 ps; CTS-only replays on the same placement: -distance_between_buffers 80/120 cut depth to 6-8 but leave boundary spread 187-233 ps; the balanced symmetric spine (clock_spine.tcl SYM, fan 16, merge 80, leaf 16 sinks / 40 um, SRAM clk pins own leaves) gives 622..652 ps over all 14,186 sinks (spread 30). Single W-mid entry on 410 x 542 um: the unpadded spine already spans 342..630 ps, so <=300 ps needs a second clock entry (die pin) -- not taken; 14,186 sinks < 15k. (2) capture fv_i[2] = one input feeding 24 distributed g_pop_keep copies through 8 buffers (435 ps): the current io_flop_at_pins anchors every capture flop of a multi-load input at its pin. (3) launch ch_rst = rsr[1] shared with the internal reset fan-out: pin_reg_split clones a dedicated launch flop. (4) recipe-3 pads HB2 instead of HB4 (in 117 -> ~60 ps). Pins = die-assigned v18 rectangles (physical/s81_die_pins/v18/ot_s81_hc_ccf.tcl, identical to the closed view); outline, macro plan, RTL and cycle counts unchanged.
